about_the_game:
Hello Operator is a narrative puzzle game where you play as Blissville’s one and only switchboard operator. In this steampunk-inspired town, every call runs through you—and every connection matters. Use your knowledge of the townsfolk, recorded in your trusty journal, and what you overhear while listening in on calls, to decide how to route conversations. Your choices shape the story, revealing secrets, relationships, and the hidden mysteries behind Blissville’s genteel facade.

Listen closely. Pay attention. The town’s fate may rest in your hands.

A point-and-click puzzle adventure where the smallest choices can carry the heaviest consequences.

short_description: Play as Blissville’s lone switchboard operator in this atmospheric, story-rich mystery. From your dimly lit station, connect calls, listen in, and uncover the secrets that bind the townsfolk—and the darkness beneath their polite masquerade.
